visual_review.confirmed_direction: Dark and bloody pixel fantasy with readable lighting; no fixed class identity.
limitations: Dense frayed cloth, hair strands and surface texture need simplification at actual game scale.
Adult elongated proportions and face remain proposals; source pixel grid and palette are not production-validated.
Views are three-quarter studies, not orthographic production turnarounds.
The cemetery vignette is generated concept art, not a Cocos screenshot.
No separated body parts, equipment fitting, anchor measurements or animation frames.
